court: High Court of Judicature at Madras
case_name: Jayaraman.K.S vs The Senior Accounts Officer on 19 November, 2025

parties.respondent_defendant: The Senior Accounts Officer, The Officer of The Principal Accountant General (Accounts and Entitlements), Tamil Nadu

facts_of_case: Petitioner married R.Seetha who died in service. Petitioner remarried Anandhavalli without disclosing the fact. Family pension was paid to petitioner till date. Respondent stopped payment of family pension and ordered recovery.

legal_principles.principle: Once the spouse of a Government Servant remarries, such spouse is not eligible to receive family pension.
legal_principles.held: As per the pension Rules, once the spouse of a Government Servant remarries, such spouse is not eligible to receive family pension.

legal_principles.principle: Registration of a marriage which has not at all taken place under Section 8 of the Hindu Marriage Act and as per the Rules made by the State Government would not be evidence of a Hindu Marriage.
legal_principles.held: Any registration of a marriage which has not at all taken place under Section 8 of the Hindu Marriage Act and as per the Rules made by the State Government would not be evidence of a Hindu Marriage and also does not confer the status of a husband and a wife to a couple.

outcome.final_order: Respondent's order stopping payment of family pension and ordering recovery is upheld.

use_for_drafting: drafting a writ petition for family pension
quashing an order denying family pension
